notices.payment_to_review.title: Payment to review: {{.Organization}}
notices.payment_to_review.body: {{.Organization}} paid {{.Amount}} for the {{.Plan}} plan by {{.Method}}. Check the transfer and approve or reject it.
notices.payment_submitted.title: Payment submitted for confirmation
notices.payment_submitted.body: Your payment of {{.Amount}} for the {{.Plan}} plan was submitted. We will let you know as soon as it is confirmed.
notices.payment_received.title: Payment received
notices.payment_received.body: We received {{.Amount}}. Your {{.Plan}} plan is active. The receipt is on its way by e-mail.
notices.payment_rejected.title: Payment not confirmed
notices.payment_rejected.body: Your payment of {{.Amount}} for the {{.Plan}} plan could not be confirmed.
notices.payment_rejected_with_reason.bod: Your payment of {{.Amount}} for the {{.Plan}} plan could not be confirmed. Reason: {{.Reason}}
notices.webhook_disabled.title: A webhook endpoint was disabled
notices.webhook_disabled.body: {{.URL}} stopped receiving events after its deliveries kept failing. Fix the receiver, then turn the endpoint back on.
notices.method.bkash._context: Payment method names, used inside a sentence ("… by bank transfer"). bKash and Nagad are brand names: keep them as they are.
